\subsection*{Data-Driven Clustering}

To assess whether the 3/1/3 DDR partition emerges from the data rather than post-hoc grouping, we apply $k$-means clustering ($k \in \{2,3,4,5\}$) to the seven features in standardized $(|\rho|, d)$ space (Table~\ref{tab:clustering}).

\begin{table}[h]
\centering
\small
\caption{$k$-means clustering of 7 features in $(|\rho|, d)$ space.}
\label{tab:clustering}
\begin{tabular}{ccp{5.5cm}}
\toprule
$k$ & Silhouette & Clusters \\
\midrule
2 & \textbf{0.632} & \{$\bar{H}$, TTR, hapax\} $\mid$ \{$\sigma_H$, $H_{\min}$, $H_{\max}$, tail\} \\
3 & 0.499 & \{$\bar{H}$, TTR, hapax\} $\mid$ \{$\sigma_H$, $H_{\max}$, tail\} $\mid$ \{$H_{\min}$\} \\
4 & 0.571 & \{$\bar{H}$, TTR, hapax\} $\mid$ \{$H_{\max}$, tail\} $\mid$ \{$\sigma_H$\} $\mid$ \{$H_{\min}$\} \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}

The primary drifting/non-drifting split ($k{=}2$, silhouette\,=\,0.632) is the strongest cluster structure.
At $k{=}3$, entropy min forms its own cluster rather than joining the near-stationary group because its pooled $|\rho|{=}0.40$ (driven by the gen-0/gen-1 boundary) places it far from other near-stationary features in $\rho$ space.
The 3/1/3 DDR partition resolves this by using the gen-1 vs.\ gen-2+ Cohen's $d$ ($d{=}0.03$) to place entropy min in the near-stationary group, a domain-informed refinement that unsupervised clustering cannot recover from pooled statistics alone.
At $k{=}4$ (silhouette\,=\,0.571), entropy std separates from the near-stationary group, consistent with its intermediate DDR classification.

\subsection*{TOST Equivalence Bound Sensitivity}
\label{app:tost-sensitivity}

Table~\ref{tab:tost-sensitivity} shows the fraction of generators for which each feature passes the TOST equivalence test (gen-1 vs.\ gen-2+, $\alpha{=}0.05$) at three equivalence bounds $\varepsilon$.

\begin{table}[h]
\centering
\small
\caption{TOST equivalence pass rate across 8 generators at varying $\varepsilon$.}
\label{tab:tost-sensitivity}
\begin{tabular}{llccc}
\toprule
\textbf{DDR Zone} & \textbf{Feature} & $\boldsymbol{\varepsilon{=}0.15}$ & $\boldsymbol{\varepsilon{=}0.20}$ & $\boldsymbol{\varepsilon{=}0.25}$ \\
\midrule
\multirow{3}{*}{Drifting} & $\bar{H}$ (ent.\ mean) & 0/8 & 0/8 & 0/8 \\
 & TTR & 0/8 & 0/8 & 0/8 \\
 & hapax ratio & 0/8 & 0/8 & 0/8 \\
\midrule
Intermediate & $\sigma_H$ (ent.\ std) & 0/8 & 0/8 & 0/8 \\
\midrule
\multirow{3}{*}{Near-stat.} & $H_{\min}$ (ent.\ min) & 7/8 & 8/8 & 8/8 \\
 & $H_{\max}$ (ent.\ max) & 6/8 & 6/8 & 6/8 \\
 & tail decay & 4/8 & 4/8 & 7/8 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}

The partition is robust to the equivalence bound: drifting features reject equivalence at all $\varepsilon$ for all generators, while entropy min passes even at the stricter bound $\varepsilon{=}0.15$ (7/8 generators).

\subsection*{Data-Driven Clustering}

To assess whether the 3/1/3 DDR partition emerges from the data rather than post-hoc grouping, we apply $k$-means clustering ($k \in \{2,3,4,5\}$) to the seven features in standardized $(|\rho|, d)$ space (Table~\ref{tab:clustering}).

\begin{table}[h]
\centering
\small
\caption{$k$-means clustering of 7 features in $(|\rho|, d)$ space.}
\label{tab:clustering}
\begin{tabular}{ccp{5.5cm}}
\toprule
$k$ & Silhouette & Clusters \\
\midrule
2 & \textbf{0.632} & \{$\bar{H}$, TTR, hapax\} $\mid$ \{$\sigma_H$, $H_{\min}$, $H_{\max}$, tail\} \\
3 & 0.499 & \{$\bar{H}$, TTR, hapax\} $\mid$ \{$\sigma_H$, $H_{\max}$, tail\} $\mid$ \{$H_{\min}$\} \\
4 & 0.571 & \{$\bar{H}$, TTR, hapax\} $\mid$ \{$H_{\max}$, tail\} $\mid$ \{$\sigma_H$\} $\mid$ \{$H_{\min}$\} \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}

The primary drifting/non-drifting split ($k{=}2$, silhouette\,=\,0.632) is the strongest cluster structure.
At $k{=}3$, entropy min forms its own cluster rather than joining the near-stationary group because its pooled $|\rho|{=}0.40$ (driven by the gen-0/gen-1 boundary) places it far from other near-stationary features in $\rho$ space.
The 3/1/3 DDR partition resolves this by using the gen-1 vs.\ gen-2+ Cohen's $d$ ($d{=}0.03$) to place entropy min in the near-stationary group, a domain-informed refinement that unsupervised clustering cannot recover from pooled statistics alone.
At $k{=}4$ (silhouette\,=\,0.571), entropy std separates from the near-stationary group, consistent with its intermediate DDR classification.

\subsection*{TOST Equivalence Bound Sensitivity}
\label{app:tost-sensitivity}

Table~\ref{tab:tost-sensitivity} shows the fraction of generators for which each feature passes the TOST equivalence test (gen-1 vs.\ gen-2+, $\alpha{=}0.05$) at three equivalence bounds $\varepsilon$.

\begin{table}[h]
\centering
\small
\caption{TOST equivalence pass rate across 8 generators at varying $\varepsilon$.}
\label{tab:tost-sensitivity}
\begin{tabular}{llccc}
\toprule
\textbf{DDR Zone} & \textbf{Feature} & $\boldsymbol{\varepsilon{=}0.15}$ & $\boldsymbol{\varepsilon{=}0.20}$ & $\boldsymbol{\varepsilon{=}0.25}$ \\
\midrule
\multirow{3}{*}{Drifting} & $\bar{H}$ (ent.\ mean) & 0/8 & 0/8 & 0/8 \\
 & TTR & 0/8 & 0/8 & 0/8 \\
 & hapax ratio & 0/8 & 0/8 & 0/8 \\
\midrule
Intermediate & $\sigma_H$ (ent.\ std) & 0/8 & 0/8 & 0/8 \\
\midrule
\multirow{3}{*}{Near-stat.} & $H_{\min}$ (ent.\ min) & 7/8 & 8/8 & 8/8 \\
 & $H_{\max}$ (ent.\ max) & 6/8 & 6/8 & 6/8 \\
 & tail decay & 4/8 & 4/8 & 7/8 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}

The partition is robust to the equivalence bound: drifting features reject equivalence at all $\varepsilon$ for all generators, while entropy min passes even at the stricter bound $\varepsilon{=}0.15$ (7/8 generators).
Tail decay is the most $\varepsilon$-sensitive near-stationary feature, passing 4/8 at $\varepsilon{=}0.20$ but 7/8 at $\varepsilon{=}0.25$; the four non-passing generators show $|d|{=}0.15$--$0.22$, still well below the drifting threshold ($d > 0.50$).
Entropy max is stable across all three bounds (6/8), with the two failures (Pythia-1B $d{=}0.21$, Pythia-2.8B $d{=}0.25$) reflecting same-family reference affinity with the Pythia-410M reference model.

审稿 R25 要求补充分析。以下实验全部用本地 feature CSVs + XGBoost，CPU 秒级。

### 任务 1：Instruct Model Retrain 实验（最高优先级）

**背景**: 审稿人指出 instruct model 上 base-trained classifier F1 崩溃（OLMo LOGO: 0.338），但 ρ 反号说明 signal 存在只是方向反转。如果 retrain on instruct data 能恢复 F1，这是突破性发现。

**数据位置**:
- `artifacts/_project/supplement/data/features_olmo-2-0425-1b-instruct.csv` (4,429 rows)
- `artifacts/_project/supplement/data/features_qwen3-1.7b-instruct.csv` (4,963 rows)
- `artifacts/_project/supplement/data/features_qwen3-0.6b-instruct.csv` (4,923 rows)
- Base features: 同目录下的 `features_*.csv`（不含 instruct 后缀的）

**分析内容**（写一个 Python 脚本完成所有分析）:

1. **Classification recovery**:

# Anonymous submission — EMNLP 2026 ARR
"""
eval_8gen_logo.py -- 8-generator LOGO cross-validation.

8 generators from features_all_models.csv (5 families):
  pythia-2.8b, pythia-1b, olmo-2-1b, qwen3-0.6b, qwen3-1.7b, qwen3-8b,
  llama-3.2-3b, mistral-7b-v0.3

Tasks:
  - 3-class LOGO: gen-0 / gen-1 / gen-2+
  - Binary LOGO: gen-1 vs gen-2+ (exclude gen-0)
  - Bootstrap 95% CI (n=1000)
  - Comparison vs 6-gen baseline
"""

import json
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from xgboost import XGBClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import f1_score

SEED = 42
FEATURES = ["entropy_mean", "entropy_std", "entropy_min", "entropy_max",
            "tail_decay", "ttr", "hapax_ratio"]

XGB_PARAMS = dict(n_estimators=200, max_depth=6, learning_rate=0.1,
                  random_state=SEED, eval_metric="mlogloss",
                  use_label_encoder=False)

CLASS_MAP_3 = {0: 0, 1: 1, 2: 2, 3: 2, 4: 2}

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
DATA_DIR = os.path.join(ROOT, "..", "data")
RESULTS_DIR = os.path.join(ROOT, "results")


def load_data():
    df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "features_all_models.csv"))
    cols = ["model_name", "seed_id", "depth"] + FEATURES
    return df[cols]


def downsample(df, label_col, rng):
    counts = df[label_col].value_counts()
    min_n = counts.min()
    parts = []
    for lbl in sorted(counts.index):
        sub = df[df[label_col] == lbl]
        parts.append(sub.sample(n=min_n, random_state=rng, replace=False))
    return pd.concat(parts, ignore_index=True)


def bootstrap_f1(y_true, y_pred, n_boot=1000, seed=SEED):
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n = len(y_true)
    scores = []
    for _ in range(n_boot):
        idx = rng.randint(0, n, size=n)
        yt, yp = y_true[idx], y_pred[idx]
        if len(np.unique(yt)) < 2:
            continue
        scores.append(f1_score(yt, yp, average="macro"))
    arr = np.array(scores)
    return float(np.mean(arr)), float(np.percentile(arr, 2.5)), float(np.percentile(arr, 97.5))


def logo_3class(df):
    df = df.copy()
    df["label"] = df["depth"].map(CLASS_MAP_3)
    generators = sorted(df["model_name"].unique())
    results = {}
    rng = np.random.RandomState(SEED)

    print("=== 3-class LOGO (gen-0 / gen-1 / gen-2+) ===")
    for gen in generators:
        test_df = df[df["model_name"] == gen]
        train_df = df[df["model_name"] != gen]
        train_ds = downsample(train_df, "label", rng)

        clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
        clf.fit(train_ds[FEATURES].values, train_ds["label"].values)
        y_pred = clf.predict(test_df[FEATURES].values)
        y_test = test_df["label"].values

        macro_f1 = f1_score(y_test, y_pred, average="macro")
        per_class = f1_score(y_test, y_pred, average=None, labels=[0, 1, 2])
        mean_f1, ci_lo, ci_hi = bootstrap_f1(y_test, y_pred)

        results[gen] = {
            "macro_f1": round(float(macro_f1), 4),
            "gen-0_f1": round(float(per_class[0]), 4),
            "gen-1_f1": round(float(per_class[1]), 4),
            "gen-2+_f1": round(float(per_class[2]), 4),
            "ci_lower": round(ci_lo, 4),
            "ci_upper": round(ci_hi, 4),
        }
        n_test = len(test_df)
        print(f"  {gen:20s}  F1={macro_f1:.4f}  95%CI=[{ci_lo:.4f}, {ci_hi:.4f}]  n={n_test}")

    avg_f1 = np.mean([r["macro_f1"] for r in results.values()])
    print(f"  {'AVERAGE':20s}  F1={avg_f1:.4f}")
    return results, round(float(avg_f1), 4)


def logo_binary(df):
    """Binary: gen-1 vs gen-2+ (exclude gen-0)."""
    df = df.copy()
    df["label3"] = df["depth"].map(CLASS_MAP_3)
    df = df[df["label3"] >= 1].copy()
    df["binary_label"] = (df["label3"] >= 2).astype(int)
    generators = sorted(df["model_name"].unique())
    results = {}
    rng = np.random.RandomState(SEED)

    print("\n=== Binary LOGO (gen-1 vs gen-2+) ===")
    for gen in generators:
        test_df = df[df["model_name"] == gen]
        train_df = df[df["model_name"] != gen]

        if test_df["binary_label"].nunique() < 2:
            print(f"  {gen:20s}  SKIPPED (single class in test)")
            continue

        train_ds = downsample(train_df, "binary_label", rng)

        clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
        clf.fit(train_ds[FEATURES].values, train_ds["binary_label"].values)
        y_pred = clf.predict(test_df[FEATURES].values)
        y_test = test_df["binary_label"].values

        f1 = f1_score(y_test, y_pred, average="macro")
        mean_f1, ci_lo, ci_hi = bootstrap_f1(y_test, y_pred)

        results[gen] = {
            "binary_f1": round(float(f1), 4),
            "ci_lower": round(ci_lo, 4),
            "ci_upper": round(ci_hi, 4),
        }
        n_test = len(test_df)
        print(f"  {gen:20s}  F1={f1:.4f}  95%CI=[{ci_lo:.4f}, {ci_hi:.4f}]  n={n_test}")

    avg_f1 = np.mean([r["binary_f1"] for r in results.values()])
    print(f"  {'AVERAGE':20s}  F1={avg_f1:.4f}")
    return results, round(float(avg_f1), 4)


def main():
    df = load_data()
    print(f"Loaded {len(df)} rows, {df['model_name'].nunique()} generators")
    for gen in sorted(df["model_name"].unique()):
        n = len(df[df["model_name"] == gen])
        depths = sorted(df[df["model_name"] == gen]["depth"].unique())
        print(f"  {gen:20s}  n={n}  depths={depths}")

    print()
    three_results, three_avg = logo_3class(df)
    binary_results, binary_avg = logo_binary(df)

    baseline_path = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "cross_generator_results.json")
    baseline_6gen_f1 = None
    baseline_6gen_per_gen = {}
    if os.path.exists(baseline_path):
        with open(baseline_path) as f:
            baseline = json.load(f)
        logo_section = baseline.get("leave_one_generator_out", {})
        if "average_macro_f1" in logo_section:
            baseline_6gen_f1 = logo_section["average_macro_f1"]
        else:
            f1s = [v["macro_f1"] for v in logo_section.values()
                   if isinstance(v, dict) and "macro_f1" in v]
            if f1s:
                baseline_6gen_f1 = round(float(np.mean(f1s)), 4)
        for gen, v in logo_section.items():
            if isinstance(v, dict) and "macro_f1" in v:
                baseline_6gen_per_gen[gen] = v["macro_f1"]

    delta_per_gen = {}
    for gen in baseline_6gen_per_gen:
        if gen in three_results:
            delta_per_gen[gen] = round(three_results[gen]["macro_f1"] - baseline_6gen_per_gen[gen], 4)

    delta_overall = None
    if baseline_6gen_f1 is not None:
        delta_overall = round(three_avg - baseline_6gen_f1, 4)

    output = {
        "experiment": "8gen_logo",
        "n_generators": 8,
        "n_total_rows": len(df),
        "overall_3class_f1": three_avg,
        "overall_binary_f1": binary_avg,
        "per_generator_3class": three_results,
        "per_generator_binary": binary_results,
        "baseline_6gen_3class_f1": baseline_6gen_f1,
        "delta_8gen_vs_6gen": delta_overall,
        "delta_per_generator_vs_6gen": delta_per_gen,
    }

    os.makedirs(RESULTS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    out_path = os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "8gen_logo_results.json")
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(output, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    print(f"\nResults saved to {out_path}")

    print(f"\n{'='*80}")
    print(f"8-gen LOGO Summary")
    print(f"{'='*80}")
    print(f"{'Generator':20s} {'3class-F1':>10s} {'95% CI':>20s} {'Binary-F1':>10s}")
    print(f"{'-'*60}")
    for gen in sorted(three_results.keys()):
        r3 = three_results[gen]
        rb = binary_results.get(gen, {})
        b_str = f"{rb['binary_f1']:.4f}" if rb else "N/A"
        print(f"{gen:20s} {r3['macro_f1']:10.4f} [{r3['ci_lower']:.4f}, {r3['ci_upper']:.4f}] {b_str:>10s}")
    print(f"{'-'*60}")
    print(f"{'AVERAGE':20s} {three_avg:10.4f} {'':20s} {binary_avg:10.4f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
r25_instruct_analysis.py — R25 review response: instruct retrain + feature ablation.

Task 1: Instruct model retrain (classification recovery, DDR structure, cross-condition transfer)
Task 2: Feature ablation supplement (3 configurations on 8-gen base data)

All CPU, XGBoost-based, seconds to run.
"""

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
from xgboost import XGBClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import f1_score
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from pathlib import Path

SEED = 42
FEATURES = ["entropy_mean", "entropy_std", "entropy_min", "entropy_max",
            "tail_decay", "ttr", "hapax_ratio"]

XGB_PARAMS = dict(n_estimators=200, max_depth=6, learning_rate=0.1,
                  random_state=SEED, eval_metric="mlogloss",
                  use_label_encoder=False)

CLASS_MAP_3 = {0: 0, 1: 1, 2: 2, 3: 2, 4: 2}

DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).parent / "supplement" / "data"

INSTRUCT_MODELS = {
    "olmo-2-0425-1b-instruct": "olmo-2-1b",
    "qwen3-1.7b-instruct": "qwen3-1.7b",
    "qwen3-0.6b-instruct": "qwen3-0.6b",
}


def load_instruct(name):
    df = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / f"features_{name}.csv")
    df["model_name"] = name
    df["label3"] = df["depth"].map(CLASS_MAP_3)
    return df


def load_base_all():
    df = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / "features_all_models.csv")
    df["label3"] = df["depth"].map(CLASS_MAP_3)
    return df


def downsample(df, label_col, rng):
    counts = df[label_col].value_counts()
    min_n = counts.min()
    parts = []
    for lbl in sorted(counts.index):
        sub = df[df[label_col] == lbl]
        parts.append(sub.sample(n=min_n, random_state=rng, replace=False))
    return pd.concat(parts, ignore_index=True)


def bootstrap_f1(y_true, y_pred, n_boot=1000, seed=SEED):
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n = len(y_true)
    scores = []
    for _ in range(n_boot):
        idx = rng.randint(0, n, size=n)
        yt, yp = y_true[idx], y_pred[idx]
        if len(np.unique(yt)) < 2:
            continue
        scores.append(f1_score(yt, yp, average="macro"))
    arr = np.array(scores)
    return float(np.percentile(arr, 2.5)), float(np.percentile(arr, 97.5))


def compute_cohens_d(g1, g2):
    n1, n2 = len(g1), len(g2)
    s1, s2 = g1.std(ddof=1), g2.std(ddof=1)
    pooled_std = np.sqrt(((n1 - 1) * s1**2 + (n2 - 1) * s2**2) / (n1 + n2 - 2))
    if pooled_std == 0:
        return 0.0
    return (g1.mean() - g2.mean()) / pooled_std


# ============================================================
# TASK 1: Instruct Model Retrain
# ============================================================

def task1_classification_recovery():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("TASK 1A: Classification Recovery (Within-Model 5-Fold CV)")
    print("=" * 70)

    base_all = load_base_all()
    results = {}

    for inst_name, base_name in INSTRUCT_MODELS.items():
        inst_df = load_instruct(inst_name)
        base_df = base_all[base_all["model_name"] == base_name].copy()

        # --- Within-model 5-fold CV on instruct data (binary) ---
        inst_bin = inst_df[inst_df["label3"] >= 1].copy()
        inst_bin["binary"] = (inst_bin["label3"] >= 2).astype(int)

        skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
        y_all_true, y_all_pred = [], []
        rng = np.random.RandomState(SEED)

        for train_idx, test_idx in skf.split(inst_bin[FEATURES], inst_bin["binary"]):
            tr = inst_bin.iloc[train_idx]
            te = inst_bin.iloc[test_idx]
            tr_ds = downsample(tr, "binary", rng)
            clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
            clf.fit(tr_ds[FEATURES].values, tr_ds["binary"].values)
            preds = clf.predict(te[FEATURES].values)
            y_all_true.extend(te["binary"].values)
            y_all_pred.extend(preds)

        y_all_true = np.array(y_all_true)
        y_all_pred = np.array(y_all_pred)
        inst_retrain_bin_f1 = f1_score(y_all_true, y_all_pred, average="macro")
        ci_lo, ci_hi = bootstrap_f1(y_all_true, y_all_pred)

        # --- Within-model 5-fold CV on instruct data (3-class) ---
        inst_3c = inst_df.copy()
        skf3 = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
        y3_true, y3_pred = [], []
        rng3 = np.random.RandomState(SEED)

        for train_idx, test_idx in skf3.split(inst_3c[FEATURES], inst_3c["label3"]):
            tr = inst_3c.iloc[train_idx]
            te = inst_3c.iloc[test_idx]
            tr_ds = downsample(tr, "label3", rng3)
            clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
            clf.fit(tr_ds[FEATURES].values, tr_ds["label3"].values)
            preds = clf.predict(te[FEATURES].values)
            y3_true.extend(te["label3"].values)
            y3_pred.extend(preds)

        y3_true = np.array(y3_true)
        y3_pred = np.array(y3_pred)
        inst_retrain_3c_f1 = f1_score(y3_true, y3_pred, average="macro")
        ci3_lo, ci3_hi = bootstrap_f1(y3_true, y3_pred)

        # --- Base-trained → instruct-tested (binary) ---
        base_bin = base_df[base_df["label3"] >= 1].copy()
        base_bin["binary"] = (base_bin["label3"] >= 2).astype(int)
        rng_base = np.random.RandomState(SEED)
        base_ds = downsample(base_bin, "binary", rng_base)

        clf_base = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
        clf_base.fit(base_ds[FEATURES].values, base_ds["binary"].values)
        base_on_inst_pred = clf_base.predict(inst_bin[FEATURES].values)
        base_on_inst_f1 = f1_score(inst_bin["binary"].values, base_on_inst_pred, average="macro")
        boi_ci_lo, boi_ci_hi = bootstrap_f1(inst_bin["binary"].values, base_on_inst_pred)

        results[inst_name] = {
            "n_instruct": len(inst_df),
            "n_base": len(base_df),
            "retrain_binary_f1": round(inst_retrain_bin_f1, 3),
            "retrain_binary_ci": [round(ci_lo, 3), round(ci_hi, 3)],
            "retrain_3class_f1": round(inst_retrain_3c_f1, 3),
            "retrain_3class_ci": [round(ci3_lo, 3), round(ci3_hi, 3)],
            "base_on_instruct_f1": round(base_on_inst_f1, 3),
            "base_on_instruct_ci": [round(boi_ci_lo, 3), round(boi_ci_hi, 3)],
        }

    print(f"\n{'Model':<30s} {'Retrain Bin F1':>14s} {'95% CI':>16s} {'Retrain 3cl F1':>14s} {'Base→Inst F1':>14s}")
    print("-" * 92)
    for name, r in results.items():
        print(f"{name:<30s} {r['retrain_binary_f1']:>14.3f} [{r['retrain_binary_ci'][0]:.3f}, {r['retrain_binary_ci'][1]:.3f}] "
              f"{r['retrain_3class_f1']:>14.3f} {r['base_on_instruct_f1']:>14.3f}")

    return results


def task1_logo_instruct():
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("TASK 1A (cont): 3-Generator LOGO on Merged Instruct Data")
    print("=" * 70)

    frames = []
    for inst_name in INSTRUCT_MODELS:
        df = load_instruct(inst_name)
        frames.append(df)
    merged = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)

    generators = sorted(merged["model_name"].unique())
    print(f"Generators: {generators}, total rows: {len(merged)}")

    # Binary LOGO
    bin_df = merged[merged["label3"] >= 1].copy()
    bin_df["binary"] = (bin_df["label3"] >= 2).astype(int)
    rng = np.random.RandomState(SEED)

    per_gen = {}
    all_true, all_pred = [], []
    for gen in generators:
        test = bin_df[bin_df["model_name"] == gen]
        train = bin_df[bin_df["model_name"] != gen]
        train_ds = downsample(train, "binary", rng)

        clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
        clf.fit(train_ds[FEATURES].values, train_ds["binary"].values)
        preds = clf.predict(test[FEATURES].values)
        y_test = test["binary"].values

        f1 = f1_score(y_test, preds, average="macro")
        ci_lo, ci_hi = bootstrap_f1(y_test, preds)
        per_gen[gen] = {"binary_f1": round(f1, 3), "ci": [round(ci_lo, 3), round(ci_hi, 3)]}
        all_true.extend(y_test)
        all_pred.extend(preds)

    all_true, all_pred = np.array(all_true), np.array(all_pred)
    avg_f1 = np.mean([v["binary_f1"] for v in per_gen.values()])
    overall_f1 = f1_score(all_true, all_pred, average="macro")
    ci_lo, ci_hi = bootstrap_f1(all_true, all_pred)

    # 3-class LOGO
    rng3 = np.random.RandomState(SEED)
    per_gen_3c = {}
    for gen in generators:
        test = merged[merged["model_name"] == gen]
        train = merged[merged["model_name"] != gen]
        train_ds = downsample(train, "label3", rng3)
        clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
        clf.fit(train_ds[FEATURES].values, train_ds["label3"].values)
        preds = clf.predict(test[FEATURES].values)
        f1_3c = f1_score(test["label3"].values, preds, average="macro")
        per_gen_3c[gen] = round(f1_3c, 3)

    print(f"\n{'Generator':<30s} {'Binary F1':>10s} {'95% CI':>16s} {'3-class F1':>12s}")
    print("-" * 72)
    for gen in generators:
        r = per_gen[gen]
        print(f"{gen:<30s} {r['binary_f1']:>10.3f} [{r['ci'][0]:.3f}, {r['ci'][1]:.3f}] {per_gen_3c[gen]:>12.3f}")
    print("-" * 72)
    print(f"{'Average':30s} {avg_f1:>10.3f}")
    print(f"{'Pooled':30s} {overall_f1:>10.3f} [{ci_lo:.3f}, {ci_hi:.3f}]")

    return {
        "per_generator": per_gen,
        "per_generator_3class": per_gen_3c,
        "average_binary_f1": round(avg_f1, 3),
        "pooled_binary_f1": round(overall_f1, 3),
        "pooled_ci": [round(ci_lo, 3), round(ci_hi, 3)],
    }


def task1_ddr_instruct():
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("TASK 1B: DDR Structure on Instruct Data")
    print("=" * 70)

    all_results = {}
    for inst_name in INSTRUCT_MODELS:
        df = load_instruct(inst_name)
        bin_df = df[df["label3"] >= 1].copy()
        gen1 = bin_df[bin_df["label3"] == 1]
        gen2p = bin_df[bin_df["label3"] == 2]

        feat_stats = {}
        for feat in FEATURES:
            rho, p_rho = stats.spearmanr(df[feat], df["depth"])
            d = compute_cohens_d(gen2p[feat], gen1[feat])
            feat_stats[feat] = {"rho": round(rho, 3), "d": round(abs(d), 3)}

        all_results[inst_name] = feat_stats

    # Print per-model DDR
    print(f"\n{'Feature':<16s}", end="")
    for name in INSTRUCT_MODELS:
        short = name.replace("-instruct", "").replace("olmo-2-0425-1b", "olmo-inst")
        print(f"  {short:>20s} ρ  {short:>10s} |d|", end="")
    print()
    print("-" * 120)
    for feat in FEATURES:
        print(f"{feat:<16s}", end="")
        for name in INSTRUCT_MODELS:
            s = all_results[name][feat]
            print(f"  {s['rho']:>22.3f}  {s['d']:>12.3f}", end="")
        print()

    # Pooled across instruct models
    frames = [load_instruct(n) for n in INSTRUCT_MODELS]
    pooled = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
    pooled_bin = pooled[pooled["label3"] >= 1]
    g1 = pooled_bin[pooled_bin["label3"] == 1]
    g2p = pooled_bin[pooled_bin["label3"] == 2]

    pooled_stats = {}
    for feat in FEATURES:
        rho, _ = stats.spearmanr(pooled[feat], pooled["depth"])
        d = compute_cohens_d(g2p[feat], g1[feat])
        pooled_stats[feat] = {"rho": round(rho, 3), "abs_rho": round(abs(rho), 3), "d": round(abs(d), 3)}

    print(f"\n{'Feature':<16s} {'Pooled ρ':>10s} {'|ρ|':>6s} {'|d|':>6s}  Zone (base)")
    print("-" * 55)
    base_zones = {
        "entropy_mean": "drifting", "ttr": "drifting", "hapax_ratio": "drifting",
        "entropy_std": "intermediate",
        "entropy_min": "near-stat", "entropy_max": "near-stat", "tail_decay": "near-stat",
    }
    for feat in FEATURES:
        s = pooled_stats[feat]
        print(f"{feat:<16s} {s['rho']:>10.3f} {s['abs_rho']:>6.3f} {s['d']:>6.3f}  {base_zones[feat]}")

    # k-means on instruct (|ρ|, d) space
    X = np.array([[pooled_stats[f]["abs_rho"], pooled_stats[f]["d"]] for f in FEATURES])
    X_scaled = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)

    print(f"\nk-means clustering on instruct (|ρ|, d):")
    km_results = {}
    for k in [2, 3]:
        km = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=SEED, n_init=20)
        labels = km.fit_predict(X_scaled)
        sil = silhouette_score(X_scaled, labels)
        clusters = {}
        for i, f in enumerate(FEATURES):
            clusters.setdefault(int(labels[i]), []).append(f)
        km_results[k] = {"silhouette": round(sil, 3), "clusters": clusters}
        print(f"  k={k}: silhouette={sil:.3f}")
        for c in sorted(clusters):
            print(f"    Cluster {c}: {clusters[c]}")

    return {"per_model": all_results, "pooled": pooled_stats, "kmeans": km_results}


def task1_cross_condition():
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("TASK 1C: Cross-Condition Transfer")
    print("=" * 70)

    base_all = load_base_all()

    # Merge instruct
    inst_frames = [load_instruct(n) for n in INSTRUCT_MODELS]
    inst_merged = pd.concat(inst_frames, ignore_index=True)

    # Corresponding base models only
    base_names = list(INSTRUCT_MODELS.values())
    base_subset = base_all[base_all["model_name"].isin(base_names)].copy()

    # Binary setup
    inst_bin = inst_merged[inst_merged["label3"] >= 1].copy()
    inst_bin["binary"] = (inst_bin["label3"] >= 2).astype(int)

    base_bin = base_subset[base_subset["label3"] >= 1].copy()
    base_bin["binary"] = (base_bin["label3"] >= 2).astype(int)

    rng = np.random.RandomState(SEED)

    # Base-trained → instruct-tested
    base_ds = downsample(base_bin, "binary", rng)
    clf_b2i = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
    clf_b2i.fit(base_ds[FEATURES].values, base_ds["binary"].values)
    pred_b2i = clf_b2i.predict(inst_bin[FEATURES].values)
    f1_b2i = f1_score(inst_bin["binary"].values, pred_b2i, average="macro")
    ci_b2i = bootstrap_f1(inst_bin["binary"].values, pred_b2i)

    # Instruct-trained → base-tested
    inst_ds = downsample(inst_bin, "binary", rng)
    clf_i2b = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
    clf_i2b.fit(inst_ds[FEATURES].values, inst_ds["binary"].values)
    pred_i2b = clf_i2b.predict(base_bin[FEATURES].values)
    f1_i2b = f1_score(base_bin["binary"].values, pred_i2b, average="macro")
    ci_i2b = bootstrap_f1(base_bin["binary"].values, pred_i2b)

    # Instruct-trained within (5-fold CV as reference)
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
    y_true_all, y_pred_all = [], []
    for tr_idx, te_idx in skf.split(inst_bin[FEATURES], inst_bin["binary"]):
        tr = inst_bin.iloc[tr_idx]
        te = inst_bin.iloc[te_idx]
        tr_ds = downsample(tr, "binary", rng)
        clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
        clf.fit(tr_ds[FEATURES].values, tr_ds["binary"].values)
        preds = clf.predict(te[FEATURES].values)
        y_true_all.extend(te["binary"].values)
        y_pred_all.extend(preds)
    y_true_all, y_pred_all = np.array(y_true_all), np.array(y_pred_all)
    f1_inst_cv = f1_score(y_true_all, y_pred_all, average="macro")
    ci_inst_cv = bootstrap_f1(y_true_all, y_pred_all)

    results = {
        "base_to_instruct": {"f1": round(f1_b2i, 3), "ci": [round(ci_b2i[0], 3), round(ci_b2i[1], 3)]},
        "instruct_to_base": {"f1": round(f1_i2b, 3), "ci": [round(ci_i2b[0], 3), round(ci_i2b[1], 3)]},
        "instruct_within_cv": {"f1": round(f1_inst_cv, 3), "ci": [round(ci_inst_cv[0], 3), round(ci_inst_cv[1], 3)]},
    }

    print(f"\n{'Condition':<30s} {'Binary F1':>10s} {'95% CI':>20s}")
    print("-" * 62)
    print(f"{'Base→Instruct (3-model)':30s} {f1_b2i:>10.3f} [{ci_b2i[0]:.3f}, {ci_b2i[1]:.3f}]")
    print(f"{'Instruct→Base (3-model)':30s} {f1_i2b:>10.3f} [{ci_i2b[0]:.3f}, {ci_i2b[1]:.3f}]")
    print(f"{'Instruct 5-fold CV':30s} {f1_inst_cv:>10.3f} [{ci_inst_cv[0]:.3f}, {ci_inst_cv[1]:.3f}]")
    print(f"\nAsymmetry (inst→base minus base→inst): {f1_i2b - f1_b2i:+.3f}")

    return results


# ============================================================
# TASK 2: Feature Ablation Supplement
# ============================================================

def task2_feature_ablation():
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("TASK 2: Feature Ablation Supplement (8-gen LOGO)")
    print("=" * 70)

    base_all = load_base_all()
    bin_df = base_all[base_all["label3"] >= 1].copy()
    bin_df["binary"] = (bin_df["label3"] >= 2).astype(int)
    generators = sorted(bin_df["model_name"].unique())

    near_stat = ["entropy_min", "entropy_max", "tail_decay"]

    configs = {
        "hapax+ent_std+3NS (no TTR, no ent_mean)": ["hapax_ratio", "entropy_std"] + near_stat,
        "ent_mean+ent_std+3NS (no TTR, no hapax)": ["entropy_mean", "entropy_std"] + near_stat,
        "Full 7-feature (reference)": FEATURES,
    }

    results = {}

    for config_name, feats in configs.items():
        rng = np.random.RandomState(SEED)
        all_true, all_pred = [], []

        per_gen_f1 = {}
        for gen in generators:
            test = bin_df[bin_df["model_name"] == gen]
            train = bin_df[bin_df["model_name"] != gen]
            train_ds = downsample(train, "binary", rng)

            clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
            clf.fit(train_ds[feats].values, train_ds["binary"].values)
            preds = clf.predict(test[feats].values)
            y_test = test["binary"].values

            f1 = f1_score(y_test, preds, average="macro")
            per_gen_f1[gen] = round(f1, 3)
            all_true.extend(y_test)
            all_pred.extend(preds)

        all_true, all_pred = np.array(all_true), np.array(all_pred)
        avg_f1 = np.mean(list(per_gen_f1.values()))
        ci_lo, ci_hi = bootstrap_f1(all_true, all_pred)

        results[config_name] = {
            "features": feats,
            "n_features": len(feats),
            "avg_binary_f1": round(avg_f1, 3),
            "ci": [round(ci_lo, 3), round(ci_hi, 3)],
            "per_generator": per_gen_f1,
        }

    # PC1 ablation
    drifting_feats = ["entropy_mean", "ttr", "hapax_ratio"]
    other_feats = ["entropy_std"] + near_stat

    rng = np.random.RandomState(SEED)
    all_true, all_pred = [], []
    per_gen_f1 = {}

    for gen in generators:
        test = bin_df[bin_df["model_name"] == gen]
        train = bin_df[bin_df["model_name"] != gen]

        # Fit PCA on training drifting features
        pca = PCA(n_components=1, random_state=SEED)
        train_pc1 = pca.fit_transform(train[drifting_feats].values)
        test_pc1 = pca.transform(test[drifting_feats].values)

        train_aug = np.hstack([train_pc1, train[other_feats].values])
        test_aug = np.hstack([test_pc1, test[other_feats].values])

        train_labels = train["binary"].values
        # Downsample
        idx_all = np.arange(len(train_labels))
        classes = np.unique(train_labels)
        min_n = min((train_labels == c).sum() for c in classes)
        ds_idx = []
        for c in classes:
            c_idx = idx_all[train_labels == c]
            ds_idx.extend(rng.choice(c_idx, size=min_n, replace=False))
        ds_idx = np.array(ds_idx)

        clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
        clf.fit(train_aug[ds_idx], train_labels[ds_idx])
        preds = clf.predict(test_aug)
        y_test = test["binary"].values

        f1 = f1_score(y_test, preds, average="macro")
        per_gen_f1[gen] = round(f1, 3)
        all_true.extend(y_test)
        all_pred.extend(preds)

    all_true, all_pred = np.array(all_true), np.array(all_pred)
    avg_f1 = np.mean(list(per_gen_f1.values()))
    ci_lo, ci_hi = bootstrap_f1(all_true, all_pred)

    results["PC1(3 drifting)+ent_std+3NS"] = {
        "features": ["PC1(ent_mean,ttr,hapax)"] + other_feats,
        "n_features": 5,
        "avg_binary_f1": round(avg_f1, 3),
        "ci": [round(ci_lo, 3), round(ci_hi, 3)],
        "per_generator": per_gen_f1,
    }

    print(f"\n{'Configuration':<45s} {'#Feat':>5s} {'Bin F1':>8s} {'95% CI':>18s}")
    print("-" * 80)
    for name, r in results.items():
        print(f"{name:<45s} {r['n_features']:>5d} {r['avg_binary_f1']:>8.3f} [{r['ci'][0]:.3f}, {r['ci'][1]:.3f}]")

    return results


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main():
    print("R25 Instruct Analysis — All CPU\n")

    # Task 1
    recovery = task1_classification_recovery()
    logo = task1_logo_instruct()
    ddr = task1_ddr_instruct()
    transfer = task1_cross_condition()

    # Task 2
    ablation = task2_feature_ablation()

    # Summary
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("SUMMARY")
    print("=" * 70)

    print("\n--- Instruct Retrain Recovery ---")
    for name, r in recovery.items():
        delta = r["retrain_binary_f1"] - r["base_on_instruct_f1"]
        print(f"  {name}: retrain={r['retrain_binary_f1']:.3f}, base→inst={r['base_on_instruct_f1']:.3f}, Δ={delta:+.3f}")

    print(f"\n--- Instruct LOGO ---")
    print(f"  3-gen LOGO binary F1: {logo['average_binary_f1']:.3f} (pooled: {logo['pooled_binary_f1']:.3f})")

    print(f"\n--- DDR on Instruct ---")
    print(f"  k=2 silhouette: {ddr['kmeans'][2]['silhouette']:.3f}")
    print(f"  k=3 silhouette: {ddr['kmeans'][3]['silhouette']:.3f}")
    drifting_rhos = [ddr['pooled'][f]['abs_rho'] for f in ['entropy_mean', 'ttr', 'hapax_ratio']]
    ns_rhos = [ddr['pooled'][f]['abs_rho'] for f in ['entropy_min', 'entropy_max', 'tail_decay']]
    print(f"  Drifting |ρ| range: {min(drifting_rhos):.3f}–{max(drifting_rhos):.3f}")
    print(f"  Near-stat |ρ| range: {min(ns_rhos):.3f}–{max(ns_rhos):.3f}")

    print(f"\n--- Cross-Condition Transfer ---")
    print(f"  Base→Instruct: {transfer['base_to_instruct']['f1']:.3f}")
    print(f"  Instruct→Base: {transfer['instruct_to_base']['f1']:.3f}")
    print(f"  Asymmetry: {transfer['instruct_to_base']['f1'] - transfer['base_to_instruct']['f1']:+.3f}")

    print(f"\n--- Feature Ablation ---")
    for name, r in ablation.items():
        print(f"  {name}: {r['avg_binary_f1']:.3f} [{r['ci'][0]:.3f}, {r['ci'][1]:.3f}]")

    import json
    output = {
        "task1_recovery": recovery,
        "task1_logo": logo,
        "task1_ddr": ddr,
        "task1_transfer": transfer,
        "task2_ablation": ablation,
    }
    out_path = Path(__file__).parent / "rebuttal" / "r25_instruct_results.json"
    out_path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(output, f, indent=2, default=str)
    print(f"\nFull results saved to {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
r25_instruct_analysis.py — R25 review response: instruct retrain + feature ablation.

Task 1: Instruct model retrain (classification recovery, DDR structure, cross-condition transfer)
Task 2: Feature ablation supplement (3 configurations on 8-gen base data)

All CPU, XGBoost-based, seconds to run.
"""

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
from xgboost import XGBClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import f1_score
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from pathlib import Path

SEED = 42
FEATURES = ["entropy_mean", "entropy_std", "entropy_min", "entropy_max",
            "tail_decay", "ttr", "hapax_ratio"]

XGB_PARAMS = dict(n_estimators=200, max_depth=6, learning_rate=0.1,
                  random_state=SEED, eval_metric="mlogloss",
                  use_label_encoder=False)

CLASS_MAP_3 = {0: 0, 1: 1, 2: 2, 3: 2, 4: 2}

DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).parent / "supplement" / "data"

INSTRUCT_MODELS = {
    "olmo-2-0425-1b-instruct": "olmo-2-1b",
    "qwen3-1.7b-instruct": "qwen3-1.7b",
    "qwen3-0.6b-instruct": "qwen3-0.6b",
}


def load_instruct(name):
    df = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / f"features_{name}.csv")
    df["model_name"] = name
    df["label3"] = df["depth"].map(CLASS_MAP_3)
    return df


def load_base_all():
    df = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / "features_all_models.csv")
    df["label3"] = df["depth"].map(CLASS_MAP_3)
    return df


def downsample(df, label_col, rng):
    counts = df[label_col].value_counts()
    min_n = counts.min()
    parts = []
    for lbl in sorted(counts.index):
        sub = df[df[label_col] == lbl]
        parts.append(sub.sample(n=min_n, random_state=rng, replace=False))
    return pd.concat(parts, ignore_index=True)


def bootstrap_f1(y_true, y_pred, n_boot=1000, seed=SEED):
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n = len(y_true)
    scores = []
    for _ in range(n_boot):
        idx = rng.randint(0, n, size=n)
        yt, yp = y_true[idx], y_pred[idx]
        if len(np.unique(yt)) < 2:
            continue
        scores.append(f1_score(yt, yp, average="macro"))
    arr = np.array(scores)
    return float(np.percentile(arr, 2.5)), float(np.percentile(arr, 97.5))


def compute_cohens_d(g1, g2):
    n1, n2 = len(g1), len(g2)
    s1, s2 = g1.std(ddof=1), g2.std(ddof=1)
    pooled_std = np.sqrt(((n1 - 1) * s1**2 + (n2 - 1) * s2**2) / (n1 + n2 - 2))
    if pooled_std == 0:
        return 0.0
    return (g1.mean() - g2.mean()) / pooled_std


# ============================================================
# TASK 1: Instruct Model Retrain
# ============================================================

def task1_classification_recovery():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("TASK 1A: Classification Recovery (Within-Model 5-Fold CV)")
    print("=" * 70)

    base_all = load_base_all()
    results = {}

    for inst_name, base_name in INSTRUCT_MODELS.items():
        inst_df = load_instruct(inst_name)
        base_df = base_all[base_all["model_name"] == base_name].copy()

        # --- Within-model 5-fold CV on instruct data (binary) ---
        inst_bin = inst_df[inst_df["label3"] >= 1].copy()
        inst_bin["binary"] = (inst_bin["label3"] >= 2).astype(int)

        skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
        y_all_true, y_all_pred = [], []
        rng = np.random.RandomState(SEED)

        for train_idx, test_idx in skf.split(inst_bin[FEATURES], inst_bin["binary"]):
            tr = inst_bin.iloc[train_idx]
            te = inst_bin.iloc[test_idx]
            tr_ds = downsample(tr, "binary", rng)
            clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
            clf.fit(tr_ds[FEATURES].values, tr_ds["binary"].values)
            preds = clf.predict(te[FEATURES].values)
            y_all_true.extend(te["binary"].values)
            y_all_pred.extend(preds)

        y_all_true = np.array(y_all_true)
        y_all_pred = np.array(y_all_pred)
        inst_retrain_bin_f1 = f1_score(y_all_true, y_all_pred, average="macro")
        ci_lo, ci_hi = bootstrap_f1(y_all_true, y_all_pred)

        # --- Within-model 5-fold CV on instruct data (3-class) ---
        inst_3c = inst_df.copy()
        skf3 = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
        y3_true, y3_pred = [], []
        rng3 = np.random.RandomState(SEED)

        for train_idx, test_idx in skf3.split(inst_3c[FEATURES], inst_3c["label3"]):
            tr = inst_3c.iloc[train_idx]
            te = inst_3c.iloc[test_idx]
            tr_ds = downsample(tr, "label3", rng3)
            clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
            clf.fit(tr_ds[FEATURES].values, tr_ds["label3"].values)
            preds = clf.predict(te[FEATURES].values)
            y3_true.extend(te["label3"].values)
            y3_pred.extend(preds)

        y3_true = np.array(y3_true)
        y3_pred = np.array(y3_pred)
        inst_retrain_3c_f1 = f1_score(y3_true, y3_pred, average="macro")
        ci3_lo, ci3_hi = bootstrap_f1(y3_true, y3_pred)

        # --- Base-trained → instruct-tested (binary) ---
        base_bin = base_df[base_df["label3"] >= 1].copy()
        base_bin["binary"] = (base_bin["label3"] >= 2).astype(int)
        rng_base = np.random.RandomState(SEED)
        base_ds = downsample(base_bin, "binary", rng_base)

        clf_base = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
        clf_base.fit(base_ds[FEATURES].values, base_ds["binary"].values)
        base_on_inst_pred = clf_base.predict(inst_bin[FEATURES].values)
        base_on_inst_f1 = f1_score(inst_bin["binary"].values, base_on_inst_pred, average="macro")
        boi_ci_lo, boi_ci_hi = bootstrap_f1(inst_bin["binary"].values, base_on_inst_pred)

        results[inst_name] = {
            "n_instruct": len(inst_df),
            "n_base": len(base_df),
            "retrain_binary_f1": round(inst_retrain_bin_f1, 3),
            "retrain_binary_ci": [round(ci_lo, 3), round(ci_hi, 3)],
            "retrain_3class_f1": round(inst_retrain_3c_f1, 3),
            "retrain_3class_ci": [round(ci3_lo, 3), round(ci3_hi, 3)],
            "base_on_instruct_f1": round(base_on_inst_f1, 3),
            "base_on_instruct_ci": [round(boi_ci_lo, 3), round(boi_ci_hi, 3)],
        }

    print(f"\n{'Model':<30s} {'Retrain Bin F1':>14s} {'95% CI':>16s} {'Retrain 3cl F1':>14s} {'Base→Inst F1':>14s}")
    print("-" * 92)
    for name, r in results.items():
        print(f"{name:<30s} {r['retrain_binary_f1']:>14.3f} [{r['retrain_binary_ci'][0]:.3f}, {r['retrain_binary_ci'][1]:.3f}] "
              f"{r['retrain_3class_f1']:>14.3f} {r['base_on_instruct_f1']:>14.3f}")

    return results


def task1_logo_instruct():
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("TASK 1A (cont): 3-Generator LOGO on Merged Instruct Data")
    print("=" * 70)

    frames = []
    for inst_name in INSTRUCT_MODELS:
        df = load_instruct(inst_name)
        frames.append(df)
    merged = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)

    generators = sorted(merged["model_name"].unique())
    print(f"Generators: {generators}, total rows: {len(merged)}")

    # Binary LOGO
    bin_df = merged[merged["label3"] >= 1].copy()
    bin_df["binary"] = (bin_df["label3"] >= 2).astype(int)
    rng = np.random.RandomState(SEED)

    per_gen = {}
    all_true, all_pred = [], []
    for gen in generators:
        test = bin_df[bin_df["model_name"] == gen]
        train = bin_df[bin_df["model_name"] != gen]
        train_ds = downsample(train, "binary", rng)

        clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
        clf.fit(train_ds[FEATURES].values, train_ds["binary"].values)
        preds = clf.predict(test[FEATURES].values)
        y_test = test["binary"].values

        f1 = f1_score(y_test, preds, average="macro")
        ci_lo, ci_hi = bootstrap_f1(y_test, preds)
        per_gen[gen] = {"binary_f1": round(f1, 3), "ci": [round(ci_lo, 3), round(ci_hi, 3)]}
        all_true.extend(y_test)
        all_pred.extend(preds)

    all_true, all_pred = np.array(all_true), np.array(all_pred)
    avg_f1 = np.mean([v["binary_f1"] for v in per_gen.values()])
    overall_f1 = f1_score(all_true, all_pred, average="macro")
    ci_lo, ci_hi = bootstrap_f1(all_true, all_pred)

    # 3-class LOGO
    rng3 = np.random.RandomState(SEED)
    per_gen_3c = {}
    for gen in generators:
        test = merged[merged["model_name"] == gen]
        train = merged[merged["model_name"] != gen]
        train_ds = downsample(train, "label3", rng3)
        clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
        clf.fit(train_ds[FEATURES].values, train_ds["label3"].values)
        preds = clf.predict(test[FEATURES].values)
        f1_3c = f1_score(test["label3"].values, preds, average="macro")
        per_gen_3c[gen] = round(f1_3c, 3)

    print(f"\n{'Generator':<30s} {'Binary F1':>10s} {'95% CI':>16s} {'3-class F1':>12s}")
    print("-" * 72)
    for gen in generators:
        r = per_gen[gen]
        print(f"{gen:<30s} {r['binary_f1']:>10.3f} [{r['ci'][0]:.3f}, {r['ci'][1]:.3f}] {per_gen_3c[gen]:>12.3f}")
    print("-" * 72)
    print(f"{'Average':30s} {avg_f1:>10.3f}")
    print(f"{'Pooled':30s} {overall_f1:>10.3f} [{ci_lo:.3f}, {ci_hi:.3f}]")

    return {
        "per_generator": per_gen,
        "per_generator_3class": per_gen_3c,
        "average_binary_f1": round(avg_f1, 3),
        "pooled_binary_f1": round(overall_f1, 3),
        "pooled_ci": [round(ci_lo, 3), round(ci_hi, 3)],
    }


def task1_ddr_instruct():
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("TASK 1B: DDR Structure on Instruct Data")
    print("=" * 70)

    all_results = {}
    for inst_name in INSTRUCT_MODELS:
        df = load_instruct(inst_name)
        bin_df = df[df["label3"] >= 1].copy()
        gen1 = bin_df[bin_df["label3"] == 1]
        gen2p = bin_df[bin_df["label3"] == 2]

        feat_stats = {}
        for feat in FEATURES:
            rho, p_rho = stats.spearmanr(df[feat], df["depth"])
            d = compute_cohens_d(gen2p[feat], gen1[feat])
            feat_stats[feat] = {"rho": round(rho, 3), "d": round(abs(d), 3)}

        all_results[inst_name] = feat_stats

    # Print per-model DDR
    print(f"\n{'Feature':<16s}", end="")
    for name in INSTRUCT_MODELS:
        short = name.replace("-instruct", "").replace("olmo-2-0425-1b", "olmo-inst")
        print(f"  {short:>20s} ρ  {short:>10s} |d|", end="")
    print()
    print("-" * 120)
    for feat in FEATURES:
        print(f"{feat:<16s}", end="")
        for name in INSTRUCT_MODELS:
            s = all_results[name][feat]
            print(f"  {s['rho']:>22.3f}  {s['d']:>12.3f}", end="")
        print()

    # Pooled across instruct models
    frames = [load_instruct(n) for n in INSTRUCT_MODELS]
    pooled = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
    pooled_bin = pooled[pooled["label3"] >= 1]
    g1 = pooled_bin[pooled_bin["label3"] == 1]
    g2p = pooled_bin[pooled_bin["label3"] == 2]

    pooled_stats = {}
    for feat in FEATURES:
        rho, _ = stats.spearmanr(pooled[feat], pooled["depth"])
        d = compute_cohens_d(g2p[feat], g1[feat])
        pooled_stats[feat] = {"rho": round(rho, 3), "abs_rho": round(abs(rho), 3), "d": round(abs(d), 3)}

    print(f"\n{'Feature':<16s} {'Pooled ρ':>10s} {'|ρ|':>6s} {'|d|':>6s}  Zone (base)")
    print("-" * 55)
    base_zones = {
        "entropy_mean": "drifting", "ttr": "drifting", "hapax_ratio": "drifting",
        "entropy_std": "intermediate",
        "entropy_min": "near-stat", "entropy_max": "near-stat", "tail_decay": "near-stat",
    }
    for feat in FEATURES:
        s = pooled_stats[feat]
        print(f"{feat:<16s} {s['rho']:>10.3f} {s['abs_rho']:>6.3f} {s['d']:>6.3f}  {base_zones[feat]}")

    # k-means on instruct (|ρ|, d) space
    X = np.array([[pooled_stats[f]["abs_rho"], pooled_stats[f]["d"]] for f in FEATURES])
    X_scaled = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)

    print(f"\nk-means clustering on instruct (|ρ|, d):")
    km_results = {}
    for k in [2, 3]:
        km = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=SEED, n_init=20)
        labels = km.fit_predict(X_scaled)
        sil = silhouette_score(X_scaled, labels)
        clusters = {}
        for i, f in enumerate(FEATURES):
            clusters.setdefault(int(labels[i]), []).append(f)
        km_results[k] = {"silhouette": round(sil, 3), "clusters": clusters}
        print(f"  k={k}: silhouette={sil:.3f}")
        for c in sorted(clusters):
            print(f"    Cluster {c}: {clusters[c]}")

    return {"per_model": all_results, "pooled": pooled_stats, "kmeans": km_results}


def task1_cross_condition():
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("TASK 1C: Cross-Condition Transfer")
    print("=" * 70)

    base_all = load_base_all()

    # Merge instruct
    inst_frames = [load_instruct(n) for n in INSTRUCT_MODELS]
    inst_merged = pd.concat(inst_frames, ignore_index=True)

    # Corresponding base models only
    base_names = list(INSTRUCT_MODELS.values())
    base_subset = base_all[base_all["model_name"].isin(base_names)].copy()

    # Binary setup
    inst_bin = inst_merged[inst_merged["label3"] >= 1].copy()
    inst_bin["binary"] = (inst_bin["label3"] >= 2).astype(int)

    base_bin = base_subset[base_subset["label3"] >= 1].copy()
    base_bin["binary"] = (base_bin["label3"] >= 2).astype(int)

    rng = np.random.RandomState(SEED)

    # Base-trained → instruct-tested
    base_ds = downsample(base_bin, "binary", rng)
    clf_b2i = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
    clf_b2i.fit(base_ds[FEATURES].values, base_ds["binary"].values)
    pred_b2i = clf_b2i.predict(inst_bin[FEATURES].values)
    f1_b2i = f1_score(inst_bin["binary"].values, pred_b2i, average="macro")
    ci_b2i = bootstrap_f1(inst_bin["binary"].values, pred_b2i)

    # Instruct-trained → base-tested
    inst_ds = downsample(inst_bin, "binary", rng)
    clf_i2b = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
    clf_i2b.fit(inst_ds[FEATURES].values, inst_ds["binary"].values)
    pred_i2b = clf_i2b.predict(base_bin[FEATURES].values)
    f1_i2b = f1_score(base_bin["binary"].values, pred_i2b, average="macro")
    ci_i2b = bootstrap_f1(base_bin["binary"].values, pred_i2b)

    # Instruct-trained within (5-fold CV as reference)
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
    y_true_all, y_pred_all = [], []
    for tr_idx, te_idx in skf.split(inst_bin[FEATURES], inst_bin["binary"]):
        tr = inst_bin.iloc[tr_idx]
        te = inst_bin.iloc[te_idx]
        tr_ds = downsample(tr, "binary", rng)
        clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
        clf.fit(tr_ds[FEATURES].values, tr_ds["binary"].values)
        preds = clf.predict(te[FEATURES].values)
        y_true_all.extend(te["binary"].values)
        y_pred_all.extend(preds)
    y_true_all, y_pred_all = np.array(y_true_all), np.array(y_pred_all)
    f1_inst_cv = f1_score(y_true_all, y_pred_all, average="macro")
    ci_inst_cv = bootstrap_f1(y_true_all, y_pred_all)

    results = {
        "base_to_instruct": {"f1": round(f1_b2i, 3), "ci": [round(ci_b2i[0], 3), round(ci_b2i[1], 3)]},
        "instruct_to_base": {"f1": round(f1_i2b, 3), "ci": [round(ci_i2b[0], 3), round(ci_i2b[1], 3)]},
        "instruct_within_cv": {"f1": round(f1_inst_cv, 3), "ci": [round(ci_inst_cv[0], 3), round(ci_inst_cv[1], 3)]},
    }

    print(f"\n{'Condition':<30s} {'Binary F1':>10s} {'95% CI':>20s}")
    print("-" * 62)
    print(f"{'Base→Instruct (3-model)':30s} {f1_b2i:>10.3f} [{ci_b2i[0]:.3f}, {ci_b2i[1]:.3f}]")
    print(f"{'Instruct→Base (3-model)':30s} {f1_i2b:>10.3f} [{ci_i2b[0]:.3f}, {ci_i2b[1]:.3f}]")
    print(f"{'Instruct 5-fold CV':30s} {f1_inst_cv:>10.3f} [{ci_inst_cv[0]:.3f}, {ci_inst_cv[1]:.3f}]")
    print(f"\nAsymmetry (inst→base minus base→inst): {f1_i2b - f1_b2i:+.3f}")

    return results


# ============================================================
# TASK 2: Feature Ablation Supplement
# ============================================================

def task2_feature_ablation():
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("TASK 2: Feature Ablation Supplement (8-gen LOGO)")
    print("=" * 70)

    base_all = load_base_all()
    bin_df = base_all[base_all["label3"] >= 1].copy()
    bin_df["binary"] = (bin_df["label3"] >= 2).astype(int)
    generators = sorted(bin_df["model_name"].unique())

    near_stat = ["entropy_min", "entropy_max", "tail_decay"]

    configs = {
        "hapax+ent_std+3NS (no TTR, no ent_mean)": ["hapax_ratio", "entropy_std"] + near_stat,
        "ent_mean+ent_std+3NS (no TTR, no hapax)": ["entropy_mean", "entropy_std"] + near_stat,
        "Full 7-feature (reference)": FEATURES,
    }

    results = {}

    for config_name, feats in configs.items():
        rng = np.random.RandomState(SEED)
        all_true, all_pred = [], []

        per_gen_f1 = {}
        for gen in generators:
            test = bin_df[bin_df["model_name"] == gen]
            train = bin_df[bin_df["model_name"] != gen]
            train_ds = downsample(train, "binary", rng)

            clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
            clf.fit(train_ds[feats].values, train_ds["binary"].values)
            preds = clf.predict(test[feats].values)
            y_test = test["binary"].values

            f1 = f1_score(y_test, preds, average="macro")
            per_gen_f1[gen] = round(f1, 3)
            all_true.extend(y_test)
            all_pred.extend(preds)

        all_true, all_pred = np.array(all_true), np.array(all_pred)
        avg_f1 = np.mean(list(per_gen_f1.values()))
        ci_lo, ci_hi = bootstrap_f1(all_true, all_pred)

        results[config_name] = {
            "features": feats,
            "n_features": len(feats),
            "avg_binary_f1": round(avg_f1, 3),
            "ci": [round(ci_lo, 3), round(ci_hi, 3)],
            "per_generator": per_gen_f1,
        }

    # PC1 ablation
    drifting_feats = ["entropy_mean", "ttr", "hapax_ratio"]
    other_feats = ["entropy_std"] + near_stat

    rng = np.random.RandomState(SEED)
    all_true, all_pred = [], []
    per_gen_f1 = {}

    for gen in generators:
        test = bin_df[bin_df["model_name"] == gen]
        train = bin_df[bin_df["model_name"] != gen]

        # Fit PCA on training drifting features
        pca = PCA(n_components=1, random_state=SEED)
        train_pc1 = pca.fit_transform(train[drifting_feats].values)
        test_pc1 = pca.transform(test[drifting_feats].values)

        train_aug = np.hstack([train_pc1, train[other_feats].values])
        test_aug = np.hstack([test_pc1, test[other_feats].values])

        train_labels = train["binary"].values
        # Downsample
        idx_all = np.arange(len(train_labels))
        classes = np.unique(train_labels)
        min_n = min((train_labels == c).sum() for c in classes)
        ds_idx = []
        for c in classes:
            c_idx = idx_all[train_labels == c]
            ds_idx.extend(rng.choice(c_idx, size=min_n, replace=False))
        ds_idx = np.array(ds_idx)

        clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
        clf.fit(train_aug[ds_idx], train_labels[ds_idx])
        preds = clf.predict(test_aug)
        y_test = test["binary"].values

        f1 = f1_score(y_test, preds, average="macro")
        per_gen_f1[gen] = round(f1, 3)
        all_true.extend(y_test)
        all_pred.extend(preds)

    all_true, all_pred = np.array(all_true), np.array(all_pred)
    avg_f1 = np.mean(list(per_gen_f1.values()))
    ci_lo, ci_hi = bootstrap_f1(all_true, all_pred)

    results["PC1(3 drifting)+ent_std+3NS"] = {
        "features": ["PC1(ent_mean,ttr,hapax)"] + other_feats,
        "n_features": 5,
        "avg_binary_f1": round(avg_f1, 3),
        "ci": [round(ci_lo, 3), round(ci_hi, 3)],
        "per_generator": per_gen_f1,
    }

    print(f"\n{'Configuration':<45s} {'#Feat':>5s} {'Bin F1':>8s} {'95% CI':>18s}")
    print("-" * 80)
    for name, r in results.items():
        print(f"{name:<45s} {r['n_features']:>5d} {r['avg_binary_f1']:>8.3f} [{r['ci'][0]:.3f}, {r['ci'][1]:.3f}]")

    return results


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main():
    print("R25 Instruct Analysis — All CPU\n")

    # Task 1
    recovery = task1_classification_recovery()
    logo = task1_logo_instruct()
    ddr = task1_ddr_instruct()
    transfer = task1_cross_condition()

    # Task 2
    ablation = task2_feature_ablation()

    # Summary
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("SUMMARY")
    print("=" * 70)

    print("\n--- Instruct Retrain Recovery ---")
    for name, r in recovery.items():
        delta = r["retrain_binary_f1"] - r["base_on_instruct_f1"]
        print(f"  {name}: retrain={r['retrain_binary_f1']:.3f}, base→inst={r['base_on_instruct_f1']:.3f}, Δ={delta:+.3f}")

    print(f"\n--- Instruct LOGO ---")
    print(f"  3-gen LOGO binary F1: {logo['average_binary_f1']:.3f} (pooled: {logo['pooled_binary_f1']:.3f})")

    print(f"\n--- DDR on Instruct ---")
    print(f"  k=2 silhouette: {ddr['kmeans'][2]['silhouette']:.3f}")
    print(f"  k=3 silhouette: {ddr['kmeans'][3]['silhouette']:.3f}")
    drifting_rhos = [ddr['pooled'][f]['abs_rho'] for f in ['entropy_mean', 'ttr', 'hapax_ratio']]
    ns_rhos = [ddr['pooled'][f]['abs_rho'] for f in ['entropy_min', 'entropy_max', 'tail_decay']]
    print(f"  Drifting |ρ| range: {min(drifting_rhos):.3f}–{max(drifting_rhos):.3f}")
    print(f"  Near-stat |ρ| range: {min(ns_rhos):.3f}–{max(ns_rhos):.3f}")

    print(f"\n--- Cross-Condition Transfer ---")
    print(f"  Base→Instruct: {transfer['base_to_instruct']['f1']:.3f}")
    print(f"  Instruct→Base: {transfer['instruct_to_base']['f1']:.3f}")
    print(f"  Asymmetry: {transfer['instruct_to_base']['f1'] - transfer['base_to_instruct']['f1']:+.3f}")

    print(f"\n--- Feature Ablation ---")
    for name, r in ablation.items():
        print(f"  {name}: {r['avg_binary_f1']:.3f} [{r['ci'][0]:.3f}, {r['ci'][1]:.3f}]")

    import json
    output = {
        "task1_recovery": recovery,
        "task1_logo": logo,
        "task1_ddr": ddr,
        "task1_transfer": transfer,
        "task2_ablation": ablation,
    }
    out_path = Path(__file__).parent / "rebuttal" / "r25_instruct_results.json"
    out_path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(output, f, indent=2, default=str)
    print(f"\nFull results saved to {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

content.thinking:
All results are in. Let me analyze and report to Director.

Key findings:

**Task 1: Instruct Retrain**

1. **Classification Recovery**: Retrain significantly recovers F1 vs base→instruct transfer:
   - OLMo: 0.590 vs 0.321 (Δ=+0.269) — massive recovery
   - Qwen3-1.7B: 0.660 vs 0.500 (Δ=+0.160)
   - Qwen3-0.6B: 0.600 vs 0.532 (Δ=+0.068)
   
   Though retrain F1 scores (0.590–0.660) still fall short of the base model's performance (~0.69–0.72), so we're seeing partial recovery rather than full restoration.

2. **LOGO on Instruct**: The 3-generation LOGO binary F1 comes in at 0.487 (0.501 when pooled), substantially lower than the base model's 8-generation LOGO (0.694), indicating weak cross-generator transfer on the instruct variant.

3. **DDR on Instruct**: Now examining the Silhouette metric at k=2.

The score drops to 0.338, well below the base model's 0.632. The drifting versus non-drifting distinction becomes much murkier on instruct data. Drifting features show correlation magnitudes between 0.357–0.491 compared to the base's 0.60–0.64, while near-stationary features compress into the 0.167–0.330 range versus base's 0.04–0.10. Instruction tuning appears to flatten the clean DDR partition. Entropy_max particularly stands out with higher effect sizes (|d|=0.224, |ρ|=0.187) on instruct, and TTR plus hapax on OLMo-instruct nearly vanish (ρ values of 0.006 and 0.025), suggesting the tuning process disrupts these linguistic markers entirely.

However, this pattern isn't universal—Qwen's instruct models preserve decent correlations for TTR and hapax (0.477–0.529), showing the effect is highly model-dependent.

Cross-condition transfer is essentially at chance: base→instruct reaches 0.490 and instruct→base drops to 0.454, with a slight asymmetry favoring base→instruct. The signal structure between these two conditions differs substantially.

For the feature ablation work, I'm testing different combinations to see which features matter most. Removing TTR or hapax individually while keeping entropy and the three non-stationary features yields 0.692, matching the result when I swap those out for entropy_mean instead. The full seven-feature model reaches 0.701, and even using just the first principal component of the drifting features plus entropy_std and the non-stationary set gives 0.692 again.

The key insight here is that any single drifting feature—or their principal component—captures nearly all the signal; the high correlation between TTR and hapax (r=0.97) means losing one costs almost nothing. This is a crucial point for the rebuttal: retraining does recover substantial signal on OLMo (+0.269), but instruction tuning fundamentally restructures the depth fingerprint rather than simply flipping its sign. The DDR partition compresses, silhouette drops from 0.632 to 0.338, and cross-condition transfer hovers near chance, confirming the underlying signal architecture has shifted.

**R25 审稿回应实验 — 全部完成**

脚本 `r25_instruct_analysis.py` 已运行，结果保存至 `rebuttal/r25_instruct_results.json`。

---

### 任务 1: Instruct Model Retrain

**1A. Classification Recovery (within-model 5-fold CV)**

| Model | Retrain Bin F1 | 95% CI | Base→Inst F1 | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| OLMo-instruct | 0.590 | [.574, .606] | 0.321 | **+0.269** |
| Qwen3-1.7B-inst | 0.660 | [.644, .675] | 0.500 | +0.160 |
| Qwen3-0.6B-inst | 0.600 | [.584, .615] | 0.532 | +0.068 |

**结论: Retrain 显著恢复 F1**（OLMo +26.9pp），但恢复后 F1（0.590–0.660）仍低于 base model 水平（0.69–0.72），说明 instruction tuning 不只是 sign flip，而是根本改变了 signal structure。

3-gen instruct LOGO: binary F1 = 0.487（pooled 0.501），远低于 base 8-gen LOGO（0.694），cross-generator transfer 在 instruct 上很弱。

**1B. DDR Structure on Instruct**

Pooled instruct (|ρ|, d):
- Drifting features |ρ|: 0.357–0.491（vs base 0.60–0.64）
- Near-stat |ρ|: 0.167–0.330（vs base 0.04–0.10）
- k=2 silhouette: **0.338**（vs base 0.632）

DDR partition 在 instruct 上严重压缩。特别是 OLMo-instruct 的 TTR/hapax ρ 接近 0（0.006/0.025），而 Qwen instruct 仍保持 0.48–0.53。高度 model-dependent。

**1C. Cross-Condition Transfer**

| Direction | Binary F1 | 95% CI |
|---|---|---|
| Base→Instruct | 0.490 | [.481, .500] |
| Instruct→Base | 0.454 | [.445, .463] |
| Instruct 5-fold CV | 0.605 | [.596, .615] |

两个方向均接近 chance level，asymmetry = -0.036（instruct→base 更差）。确认 base 和 instruct 的 depth signal 结构不同，classifier 不可直接迁移。

---

### 任务 2: Feature Ablation

| Configuration | #Feat | Bin F1 | 95% CI |
|---|---|---|---|
| hapax + ent_std + 3NS (no TTR, no ent_mean) | 5 | 0.692 | [.686, .697] |
| ent_mean + ent_std + 3NS (no TTR, no hapax) | 5 | 0.692 | [.686, .697] |
| PC1(3 drifting) + ent_std + 3NS | 5 | 0.692 | [.686, .697] |
| **Full 7-feature (reference)** | **7** | **0.701** | [.694, .706] |

所有 5-feature 配置 F1 = 0.692，仅比 full 7-feature 低 0.009（落在 CI 重叠区间内）。**任何单个 drifting feature（或 PC1）都能替代另外两个 drifting features，几乎无损**。这进一步确认 effective dimensionality ≈ 5，TTR-hapax r=0.97 的冗余性。

---

### 对 Rebuttal 的启示

1. **Instruct retrain IS a breakthrough story**: retrain 恢复 +7–27pp，证明 signal 存在但 direction/structure 不同
2. **DDR partition disruption**: instruct 上 silhouette 从 0.632 降至 0.338，drifting/near-stat 分离变模糊
3. **Cross-condition near-chance**: 证实 instruction tuning 根本改变 depth fingerprint，不只是 sign flip
4. **Ablation**: effective dim ≈ 5 有了直接消融证据支撑
